metadata.title: LA Times, Sun, Oct 10, 2010 - "Perfection"
metadata.author: Don Gagliardo / Ed. Rich Norris & Joyce Nichols Lewis

entries.clue: Work on, as pipe bowl ash
Whole that's greater than the sum of its parts
It's transferred from iron to pants during pressing
Ship that survived the Clashing Rocks
Instrument that's not seen and not heard
Like "park the car," to a New Englander?
155-mi. Asian strip that intersects the 38th parallel
1960 chart topper with the line "Are you somewhere up above"
Theme answer count, amount of letters in each, word hidden in each, and, when repeated twice, today's date
Disney no longer used them after "The Little Mermaid"
It can make your heart pound
